name: Super Monkey Fan Club
effect: Temporarily transforms eligible nearby Dart Monkeys into rapid-attacking forms.

name: Plasma Monkey Fan Club
effect: Replaces the Fan Club transformation with stronger plasma forms.

name: Turbo Charge
effect: Temporarily increases attack speed.

name: Perma Charge
effect: Adds a temporary damage boost to its permanently fast attacks.

name: MOAB Assassin
effect: Launches a high-damage missile at a MOAB-class target.

name: MOAB Eliminator
effect: Upgrades the missile ability and reduces its cooldown.

name: Bomb Storm
effect: Triggers a broad emergency attack when the life-loss condition is met.

name: Blade Maelstrom
effect: Emits a rotating barrage of blades around the tower.

name: Super Maelstrom
effect: Emits a stronger, longer blade barrage.

name: Snowstorm
effect: Freezes ordinary Bloons across the map and slows eligible MOAB-class targets.

name: Absolute Zero
effect: Strengthens the global freeze and grants Ice Monkey support effects.

name: Glue Strike
effect: Applies global glue with Lead-immunity removal and increased damage taken.

name: Glue Storm
effect: Repeatedly applies the global glue effect over a duration.

name: Take Aim
effect: Temporarily grants a selected tower more range, better accuracy, and Camo detection.

name: Marked to Pop
effect: Marks a target to take extra Desperado damage and yield additional pop cash. The inspected model has a 2x Desperado-damage multiplier and a 2x pop-cash multiplier.

name: Nomad life-loss response
effect: Can trigger temporary combat bonuses and cash recovery when lives are lost.

name: Avenger protection
effect: Adds temporary protection against life loss under its trigger conditions.

name: Supply Drop
effect: Drops a collectible cash crate.

name: Elite Supply Drop
effect: Improves the cash crate ability; this is a descriptive label for the upgraded Supply Drop.

name: Elite Defender retaliation
effect: Temporarily increases attack speed when lives are lost.

name: Submerge
effect: Stops normal dart attacks and activates the submerged support behavior.

name: First Strike Capability
effect: Launches a high-damage missile at the strongest target with an area explosion.

name: Pre-emptive missiles
effect: Automatically attacks newly entering MOAB-class targets; the activated missile remains available.

name: MOAB Takedown
effect: Harpoons an eligible MOAB-class target and removes it.

name: Pirate Lord takedown
effect: Upgrades the harpoon ability to capture multiple eligible targets and increases capture income.

name: Ground Zero
effect: Detonates a map-wide bomb.

name: Tsar Bomba
effect: Detonates a stronger map-wide bomb with control effects.

name: Supply Drop
effect: Delivers cash and lives by helicopter.

name: Redeploy
effect: Moves an eligible placed tower to a new legal position.

name: Deploy Marine
effect: Temporarily deploys a powerful Monkey Marine.

name: Comanche reinforcements
effect: Calls temporary supporting helicopters when its pressure conditions are met.

name: Bombardment
effect: Temporarily increases the Artillery Battery's firing rate.

name: Pop and Awe
effect: Applies map-wide damage and stuns to eligible targets.

name: Rocket Storm
effect: Fires a temporary guided rocket barrage.

name: M.A.D Rocket Storm
effect: Retains an upgraded missile-barrage ability; the label identifies the M.A.D variant.

name: Summon Phoenix
effect: Summons a temporary attacking Phoenix.

name: Wizard Lord Phoenix
effect: Activates a stronger Phoenix form and fire attacks.

name: Annihilation
effect: Deals a large burst of damage around the tower.

name: Anti-Bloon Annihilation
effect: Upgrades the area-damage ability; the label distinguishes the tier-five form.

name: Darkshift
effect: Teleports the tower to a nearby legal position.

name: Darkshift, global
effect: Extends teleport placement to the map.

name: Legend of the Night black hole
effect: Temporarily absorbs leaking enemies when its emergency condition activates.

name: Bloon Sabotage
effect: Temporarily slows eligible enemies across the map.

name: Grand Sabotage
effect: Extends sabotage and reduces health of newly entering eligible MOAB-class targets.

name: Transforming Tonic
effect: Temporarily transforms the Alchemist into a rapid-attacking monster.

name: Total Transformation
effect: Temporarily transforms eligible nearby towers into attacking monsters.

name: Vine Crush
effect: Targets multiple eligible enemies with crushing vines. This is the ability named in the retrieved export, not the older manual income ability.

name: Spirit of the Forest Vine Crush
effect: Improves Vine Crush while permanent track vines continue attacking.

name: Ice Jet
effect: Releases bouncing ice projectiles.

name: Popseidon Ice Jet
effect: Upgrades the cold-projectile ability and its area effects.

name: Alluring Melody
effect: Diverts eligible Bloons toward a song source and interacts with damage-over-time effects.

name: Song position
effect: Sets the lure position within its permitted placement area.

name: Global song position
effect: Extends the permitted lure position across the map.

name: Long-range stance
effect: Switches to slower, more accurate long-range firing.

name: Thunder Charge
effect: Temporarily improves nearby towers' projectile behavior, with ricochet and Frozen-popping benefits.

name: Thunder Charge, conduit links
effect: Also links electrical conduits with lightning.

name: Bank collection
effect: Withdraws stored bank cash. This is a collection control rather than a cooldown ability.

name: IMF Loan
effect: Provides a cash loan that later income must repay.

name: Monkey-Nomics
effect: Provides cash without loan debt.

name: Spike Storm
effect: Spreads spike piles across the track.

name: Carpet of Spikes
effect: Periodically spreads spikes across the track; an activated spike spread remains available.

name: Call to Arms
effect: Temporarily increases affected towers' attack speed and pierce.

name: Homeland Defense
effect: Applies the stronger attack-speed and pierce buff across the map.

name: Overclock
effect: Temporarily boosts a selected eligible tower's attack speed or compatible production behavior.

name: Ultraboost
effect: Adds a permanent stacking improvement as well as the temporary boost.

name: Collect Bloon Trap
effect: Collects cash from a full trap so that another can be placed.

name: Collect XXXL Trap
effect: Collects a full large trap that can capture eligible MOAB-class targets.

name: T-Rex Stomp
effect: The dinosaur produces a damaging stun stomp.

name: Giganotosaurus Stomp
effect: Upgrades the stomp to stronger, wider control.

name: Beast merge
effect: Assigns compatible handlers to support one beast and increase its Beast Power; available for all three beast paths.

name: Beast position
effect: Sets a permitted beast position; the valid region depends on the beast type.
